# Semantic Review — This PR adds 5 endpoints, 2 new DB writes to `AdImpression`, `User`, 2 new external calls to `httpx.post -> https://moderate.visionapi.io/scan`, `requests.post -> https://ads.growthly.io/track` and 4 new PII signals and removes 1 endpoint.

`HEAD^` → `HEAD`  |  line diff: 

**10 semantic changes** — 🔴 4  🟡 2  🟢 4

| | change | route |
|--|--------|-------|
| 🔴 | NEW ENDPOINT | `discover/users` |
| 🔴 | NEW ENDPOINT | `account/delete` |
| 🔴 | CHANGED | `posts` |
| 🔴 | CHANGED | `stories` |
| 🟡 | NEW ENDPOINT | `ads/click` |
| 🟡 | REMOVED ENDPOINT | `notifications` |
| 🟢 | CHANGED | `feed` |
| 🟢 | CHANGED | `trending` |
| 🟢 | NEW ENDPOINT | `health` |
| 🟢 | NEW ENDPOINT | `billing/subscribe` |

### 🔀 Flow (before → after)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant NDiscoverUsersView as DiscoverUsersView
    Client->>NDiscoverUsersView: 🆕 GET discover/users
    NDiscoverUsersView->>Database: read User
    participant NAccountDeleteView as AccountDeleteView
    Client->>NAccountDeleteView: 🆕 POST account/delete
    NAccountDeleteView->>Database: read User
    NAccountDeleteView->>Database: write User
    participant NPostCreateView as PostCreateView
    Client->>NPostCreateView: 🔴 POST posts
    NPostCreateView->>Database: write Post
    NPostCreateView->>External: https://moderate.visionapi.io/scan
    NPostCreateView->>External: https://ads.growthly.io/track
    participant NStoriesView as StoriesView
    Client->>NStoriesView: 🔴 GET stories
    NStoriesView->>Database: read Story
    participant NAdClickView as AdClickView
    Client->>NAdClickView: 🆕 POST ads/click
    NAdClickView->>Database: write AdImpression
    participant NNotificationsView as NotificationsView
    Client->>NNotificationsView: ➖ GET notifications
    participant NFeedView as FeedView
    Client->>NFeedView: 🟢 GET feed
    NFeedView->>Database: read Post
    participant NTrendingView as TrendingView
    Client->>NTrendingView: 🟢 GET trending
    NTrendingView->>Database: read Post
    participant NHealthView as HealthView
    Client->>NHealthView: 🆕 GET health
    participant NSubscribeView as SubscribeView
    Client->>NSubscribeView: 🆕 POST billing/subscribe
```

+from .models import AdImpression, Comment, Follow, Post, Story, User
+from .tasks import notify_followers
+
+ADS = "https://ads.growthly.io/track"
+MODERATION = "https://moderate.visionapi.io/scan"
 
 
 class FeedView(APIView):
     permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
 
     def get(self, request):
+        cached = cache.get("feed:%s" % request.user.id)          # NEW cache read
+        if cached:
+            return Response(cached)
         posts = Post.objects.filter(author__in=request.user.following.all())
-        return Response({"posts": list(posts.values("id", "caption"))})
+        data = {"posts": list(posts.values("id", "caption"))}
+        cache.set("feed:%s" % request.user.id, data, 60)         # NEW cache write
+        return Response(data)
 
 
 class PostCreateView(APIView):
     permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
 
     def post(self, request):
+        httpx.post(MODERATION, json={"media_url": request.data["media_url"]})   # NEW external (moderation)
         post = Post.objects.create(
             author=request.user, caption=request.data["caption"],
             media_url=request.data["media_url"])
+        notify_followers.delay(post.id)                          # NEW async fan-out
+        requests.post(ADS, json={"email": request.user.email, "caption": post.caption})  # NEW external + PII egress
         return Response({"id": post.id})
 
 
@@ -56,7 +72,7 @@ class ProfileView(APIView):
 
 
 class StoriesView(APIView):
-    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
+    permission_classes = [AllowAny]        # CHANGED: was IsAuthenticated

     def get(self, request):
         return Response({"trending": list(Post.objects.values("id", "caption")[:20])})
 
 
-class NotificationsView(APIView):
-    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
+class DiscoverUsersView(APIView):
+    permission_classes = [AllowAny]        # NEW public endpoint
+    def get(self, request):
+        users = User.objects.all()
+        return Response({"users": [
+            {"username": u.username, "email": u.email, "phone": u.phone} for u in users]})
+
+
+class AdClickView(APIView):
+    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]     # NEW — records ad impressions
+    def post(self, request):
+        AdImpression.objects.create(user=request.user, campaign=request.data["campaign"])
+        return Response({"ok": True})
+
 
+class HealthView(APIView):
+    permission_classes = [AllowAny]        # NEW benign endpoint (no data)
     def get(self, request):
-        return Response({"notifications": []})
+        return Response({"ok": True})
+
+
+class SubscribeView(APIView):
+    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]     # NEW — Instagram Pro subscription
+    def post(self, request):
+        stripe.Subscription.create(customer=request.data["customer"], items=[{"price": "pro"}])
+        return Response({"ok": True})
+
+
+class AccountDeleteView(APIView):
+    permission_classes = [AllowAny]        # NEW public endpoint — destructive
